nodes.label: PPPoE speed source order
nodes.rationale: comments, then profile_rate_limit, then profile_name, then default

nodes.label: LQoSync3 (lqosync3 tool)
nodes.rationale: Rust replacement for updatecsv.py; reads MikroTik routers, writes LibreQoS shaping input; settings from one TOML file

nodes.norm_label: adr-0006 v3 guards and node types

nodes.label: ADR-0007 Fresh design, not a port
nodes.norm_label: adr-0007 fresh design, not a port

nodes.label: ADR-0001 One model, many writers
nodes.rationale: One crate, one circuit model, one writer per target; collector/speed rules/topology/validator shared. Pair-only lacks v3 strict gate, stable IDs, VLAN/MPLS; network-only needs a 2.2 converter anyway. Status accepted.

nodes.label: ADR-0002 v3 target selection
nodes.rationale: Auto-select per cycle from version and v3 topology source; fixed TOML target overrides. Rejected fixed-only (upgrade writes wrong format) and write-all (confusing). Status proposed pending v3 test shaper.

nodes.label: Router state model (online/failed/unreachable/offline)
nodes.rationale: Failed router keeps last good rows; offline router loses subscribers after offline_after; inactive removal only from online routers; avoids short outage wiping shaping

nodes.label: Profile name number+unit rule
nodes.rationale: Tier-15M-WAN1 gives 15 not 1; single value accepts only M

nodes.label: All policy in TOML
nodes.rationale: Operator wants tunables out of code; only LibreQoS/RouterOS-defined formats stay in code

nodes.label: flat_promotion parent fix
nodes.rationale: updatecsv.py left circuit Parent Node empty so no circuit was in its client node

nodes.label: Stable node id (lq3- FNV-1a 64)
nodes.rationale: Name-derived v3 IDs change on rename; stable id avoids that

nodes.label: no_parent guard on v3 targets
nodes.rationale: Empty Parent Node ID holds v3 bridge boot gate; synthetic root would put all circuits on one HTB root/CPU

nodes.label: Group nodes typed site on v3
nodes.norm_label: group nodes typed site on v3
nodes.rationale: ap_site may drop plan nodes and lose group caps

nodes.label: Fresh design, not a port
nodes.rationale: Operator wants high performance and data integrity; Python quirks not copied; no byte parity

nodes.label: lqosync3 tui (ratatui/crossterm)
nodes.rationale: Service runs under systemd without terminal; separate process avoids socket API and access control

nodes.label: Temp file then rename write
nodes.rationale: Watcher rejects symlinks

nodes.label: Removal guard (>20% or >50 rows)
nodes.rationale: Hold a cycle that removes too many rows

nodes.label: Speed rules rate_limit_order/unitless_unit
nodes.rationale: Defaults routeros_rx_tx and bps are RouterOS-correct; operator selected

nodes.label: /run/lqos/bus 0777 safety caution
nodes.rationale: Production bus is world-writable; block sockets with strace inject and never call validate_shaped_devices.

nodes.label: Router credentials in 0600 files
nodes.rationale: Passwords never in TOML; read-only router access

nodes.label: Shadow mode
nodes.rationale: Installer starts in shadow mode: no LibreQoS file writes, allows compare with Python service before cutover

nodes.label: Target auto-detection
nodes.rationale: Selects target from installed LibreQoS version and v3 topology source

nodes.label: Write files only on content change
nodes.norm_label: write files only on content change

nodes.label: Config Loader
nodes.rationale: Rejects unknown keys and reads secrets from files so typos stop startup and no secret sits in TOML.

nodes.label: Six Network Modes
nodes.rationale: Kept from updatecsv.py: grouped_router_root, flat_router_root, flat_global_root, no_parent, root_promotion, flat_promotion.

nodes.label: DHCP speed sources (per_site / per_plan)
nodes.rationale: per_site rejects lease_comment because site node rate is lease count times one server rate.

nodes.label: lqosync3.toml config file
nodes.rationale: Policy and tuning in TOML; formats fixed by LibreQoS/RouterOS (API paths, CSV columns, file names, schema) stay in code.

nodes.label: lqosync3.service systemd unit
nodes.rationale: No ProtectSystem=strict because v2_pair reload LibreQoS.py --updateonly needs full system access.

nodes.label: v2 vs v3 writer differences
nodes.rationale: Tool rejects duplicate IPs and duplicate node names itself because v3 compiler does not, keeping both targets equal.

nodes.label: Writers (one per target)
nodes.rationale: One model, many writers (ADR-0001): each writer converts the same model to its file format.

nodes.label: Name templates ([nodes], [circuits])
nodes.rationale: Changing a [circuits] template on a live system renames circuits, so rows are removed and re-added with new IDs.

nodes.label: Node type defaults per target
nodes.rationale: v3 does not accept type plan; ap_site compile mode keeps only site and ap nodes (ADR-0006).

nodes.label: Task 7: Pair writer (render_csv, render_network_json)
nodes.rationale: Byte-match Python csv quoting and json four-space indent so files diff cleanly against updatecsv.py output.

nodes.label: Output format (round3, fmt_rate, CSV sort, JSON indent)
nodes.norm_label: output format (round3, fmt_rate, csv sort, json indent)

nodes.label: Comment speed format (Name|25M/5M)
nodes.rationale: Form 3 accepts only M and unit must end the word so names like 'Wifi 5G' or '5Main' are not speeds.

nodes.label: Task 2: Rate format and speed rules (SpeedParser)
nodes.norm_label: task 2: rate format and speed rules (speedparser)

nodes.label: Circuit rules per source (PPPoE, Hotspot, DHCP)
nodes.norm_label: circuit rules per source (pppoe, hotspot, dhcp)

nodes.label: Circuit rate formula (clamp, max_floor, min_rate_percentage)
nodes.rationale: LibreQoS 2.2 and v3 reject max below 0.2 and min below 0.1 Mbps.

nodes.label: Differences from updatecsv.py
nodes.rationale: Fresh design, not a port (ADR-0007): RouterOS rx/tx order, bit/s unitless, keep rows on router failure, removal guard, 0.2 max floor, atomic writes.

nodes.label: Removal Guard ([safety])
nodes.rationale: A bad router reply can make many subscribers vanish in one cycle; hold removal above max_removed_count/percent until next cycle confirms or force.

nodes.label: Circuit Model
nodes.rationale: Uses sorted BTreeMap so output order is stable and content hash only changes on real changes.

nodes.label: RouterOS listen change detection (future)
nodes.rationale: mikrotik-rs 0.7.0 supports streamed replies; needs router test first, full poll stays as periodic check.

nodes.label: Router State settings (offline_after, offline_action)
nodes.rationale: Offline means API unreachable, not traffic down; make offline_after longer than usual network problems.

nodes.label: Performance Rules
nodes.rationale: Slow parts are router API calls and LibreQoS reload: parallel tokio task per router, persistent sessions, per-call timeouts, SHA-256 hash skip, atomic rename (lqosd watcher rejects symlinks), active/idle intervals.

nodes.label: Router State Machine (online/failed/unreachable/offline)
nodes.rationale: Failed router keeps its subscribers; offline router loses them after offline_after (ADR-0003). Only online routers remove inactive subscribers.

nodes.label: Task 3: Model, state file, and seed
nodes.norm_label: task 3: model, state file, and seed

nodes.label: Plan 1 global constraints
nodes.rationale: Only six deps (serde, serde_json, toml, csv, regex, anyhow), no preserve_order; core does no I/O, clock, or random access; each task ends with test, clippy, fmt green.

nodes.label: assemble() pure core function
nodes.rationale: One cycle is one function call with no file, network, or clock access, so the core is deterministic and scenario-testable.

nodes.label: Guard hold fingerprint (FNV-1a 64 of removed names)
nodes.norm_label: guard hold fingerprint (fnv-1a 64 of removed names)

nodes.label: Stable node id (lq3- + FNV-1a 64)
nodes.rationale: Hash of kind|router|key so a name template change does not change the id (ADR-0005).

nodes.label: Task 8: Scenario tests and v3 check
nodes.norm_label: task 8: scenario tests and v3 check

nodes.label: Scenario tests (synthetic fixtures)
nodes.rationale: Expected files are written from the spec, not from updatecsv.py; fixtures stay synthetic to keep subscriber data out of the repo.

nodes.label: Target Detector
nodes.rationale: Stops when v3 topology source is a built-in integration (uisp, splynx) so the tool never writes files another source owns.

nodes.label: Runtime modes (shadow / apply)
nodes.rationale: shadow writes candidate files to state_dir/candidate/ to compare with the Python service before cutover.

nodes.label: install.sh one-line installer
nodes.rationale: Target contract; installs in shadow mode, never touches the Python service, LibreQoS files, packages, or routers.

nodes.label: LibreQoS upgrade 2.2 to 3.x
nodes.rationale: v3 is beta and libreqos_network.json undocumented; start with shaped_devices source (v3_pair) then move to libreqos_network after a stable period.

nodes.label: Delivery in five plans (Core, Runtime, v3, TUI, Install)
nodes.norm_label: delivery in five plans (core, runtime, v3, tui, install)

nodes.label: Operational rules
nodes.rationale: Only one sync tool in apply mode per shaper, since two writers of the same LibreQoS files conflict.
